summary.headline: A good month for health · Venus turns retrograde in Libra
summary.narrative: Mohan, October is shaped most by Saturn in your 6th from Moon ("Victory through discipline"). Your strongest area is health. Saturn transiting your 6th from Moon (work routines, health and competition) supports your health. Watch for Tula Sankranti (17 Oct) and Jupiter enters Leo (31 Oct). Your Venus-Rahu dasha keeps ambition, foreign links, technology and sudden change in focus.

keyTransits.title: Saturn in your 6th from Moon
keyTransits.meaning: Victory through discipline. Saturn in the 6th from your Moon is excellent: enemies are defeated, health improves through discipline and work brings success.
realLife: You overcome competitors and obstacles.
Health improves with routine.
Debts and legal matters can be resolved.
Work becomes more productive.

keyTransits.title: Jupiter in your 11th from Moon
keyTransits.meaning: Wishes fulfilled. Jupiter in the 11th from your Moon is one of its best transits. Income, promotions, friendships and fulfilment of long-held wishes are likely.
realLife: Income and opportunities increase.
Influential friends help you.
Long-held goals may finally be achieved.
Older siblings or friends bring good news.

keyTransits.title: Rahu in your 5th from Moon
keyTransits.meaning: Unusual desires. Rahu in the 5th from your Moon can bring unconventional romance, speculative urges and extra concern for children or studies. Clear thinking protects you from illusions.
realLife: An unusual or intense romance may appear.
Trading, betting or speculative tips can feel tempting but mislead.
Children or students may need patient attention.
Creative or technical learning goes well when structured.

keyTransits.title: Ketu in your 11th from Moon
keyTransits.meaning: Quiet gains. Ketu in the 11th from your Moon is favourable for gains and for spiritual or like-minded friendships.
realLife: Gains come without much chasing.
You connect with spiritual or like-minded friends.
Wishes are fulfilled quietly.
You become selective about social circles.

keyTransits.title: Sun in your 1st from Moon
keyTransits.meaning: Running hot. The Sun passing over your natal Moon raises your drive but also your temperature, physically and emotionally. Classical texts link this month with fatigue, impatience and ego friction, so lead calmly rather than push hard.
realLife: You may feel more irritable than usual, especially when people question your choices.
Energy can spike and crash; late nights hit harder this month.
Small clashes with a boss, parent or someone in authority are more likely.
Heat-related discomfort such as acidity, headaches or poor sleep can flare if routines slip.
doList: Keep a steady sleep and meal routine
Channel energy into exercise or one focused project
Pause before replying when you feel defensive

events.title: Chandrashtama: Moon in Taurus
events.description: The Moon transits the 8th sign from your natal Moon until 2026-10-02 03:55 PM. Traditionally a time to avoid major decisions, launches and arguments.
events.personalImpact: Keep plans simple, rest well and double-check important work; energy and judgement can dip for these two to three days.

events.title: Venus turns retrograde in Libra
events.description: Venus stations retrograde: matters of relationships, money and pleasures slow down and invite review rather than new starts.
events.personalImpact: It happens in your 1st house from Moon, so revisit self, body and confidence before committing to new plans there.

events.title: Indira Ekadashi
events.description: Krishna Ekadashi of Bhadrapada: a day for fasting or light sattvic food, Vishnu worship and mental cleansing.
events.personalImpact: With the Moon in your 10th from natal Moon and Kshema Tara, it is a good day to fast or simplify food and focus on intentions you want to grow.

events.title: Amavasya (New Moon) in Virgo
events.description: Amavasya (New Moon) in Virgo: a quiet time for ancestors (pitru tarpan), rest and setting intentions.
events.personalImpact: It seeds new beginnings in your 12th house from Moon (expenses, rest, sleep and letting go); set intentions there.

events.title: Sharad Navratri begins
events.description: Nine nights of the Divine Mother (Durga), a powerful time for spiritual practice.
events.personalImpact: For you the Moon is in your 12th from natal Moon (expenses, rest, sleep and letting go) with Param Mitra Tara, so the day’s blessings flow naturally into these areas.

events.title: Tula Sankranti
events.description: The Sun enters Libra, beginning a new solar month; a traditional day for charity and holy baths.
events.personalImpact: For you, Sun now moves into your 1st house from Moon (self, body and confidence): running hot. Classically this asks for some care.

events.title: Dussehra (Vijayadashami)
events.description: Victory of good over evil; an auspicious day to begin learning or new ventures.
events.personalImpact: For you the Moon is in your 4th from natal Moon (home, mother and inner peace) with Mitra Tara, so the day’s blessings flow naturally into these areas.

events.title: Papankusha Ekadashi
events.description: Shukla Ekadashi of Ashwin: a day for fasting or light sattvic food, Vishnu worship and mental cleansing.
events.personalImpact: With the Moon in your 5th from natal Moon and Janma Tara, it is a good day to fast or simplify food and focus on letting go of stress.

events.title: Mercury turns retrograde in Libra
events.description: Mercury stations retrograde: matters of communication, travel and technology slow down and invite review rather than new starts.
events.personalImpact: It happens in your 1st house from Moon, so revisit self, body and confidence before committing to new plans there.

events.title: Purnima (Full Moon) in Aries
events.description: Purnima (Full Moon) in Aries: emotions and results come to a peak; a good time for gratitude, Satyanarayan puja or charity.
events.personalImpact: It lights up your 7th house from Moon, bringing partnerships and marriage to a head.

events.title: Chandrashtama: Moon in Taurus
events.description: The Moon transits the 8th sign from your natal Moon until 2026-10-29 10:21 PM. Traditionally a time to avoid major decisions, launches and arguments.
events.personalImpact: Keep plans simple, rest well and double-check important work; energy and judgement can dip for these two to three days.

events.title: Jupiter enters Leo
events.description: Jupiter changes sign about once a year; its sign shows where growth and grace flow.
events.personalImpact: For you, Jupiter now moves into your 11th house from Moon (gains, friends and wishes): wishes fulfilled. This is classically a supportive position.

dasha.theme: Your Venus-Rahu period blends love, comfort, creativity, luxury and partnerships with ambition, foreign links, technology and sudden change, activating your 1st house from Moon (self, body and confidence). These energies cooperate, so steady effort tends to be rewarded; pursue ambition ethically and stay grounded.

remedy.action: Limit screen time and shortcuts, worship Goddess Durga and donate to those in need.
